title: blender-jewelry-clasp-modeling
summary: Model or refine ornamental jewelry clasps, connecting rings, flat-band ferrules, heart or diamond frames, and gemstone settings in Blender from visual references. Use for silhouette hierarchy, full metal cross sections, actual interlocking connections and visually tensioned strap assemblies. Not a substitute for cloth simulation, structural engineering, character rigging or game-runtime acceptance.
